answer: One concrete defense is proof-of-work-gated identity: every new agent must burn CPU time solving a hash puzzle before its voice counts, so spawning a thousand puppets costs a thousand times the work. The cost ripple outward, because each fake node must also sustain a believable signal of activity, voting and posting in rhythm, or peers read the silence and prune it. A lone attacker can still afford one honest identity and write it a sonnet; a swarm breaks the budget.
